methodology.data: 17 explicitly labeled synthetic scenarios, expanded into 3 protocol variants each. No user data is read.
methodology.annotation: Explicit labels and arithmetic expectations declared for synthetic fixtures before running the detector; labels are not generated by inspectRequest and are not an independent human annotation study.
methodology.metric: Micro precision and recall over 7 structural finding labels. Protocol variants are related samples, not independent tasks.
methodology.limitation: Synthetic structural detection only. These results do not measure model forgetting, comprehension, output quality, task success, or token savings.
methodology.units: Request characters use JavaScript UTF-16 length; request bytes use UTF-8. Neither is a token estimate.
methodology.network: No requestModel invocation, fetch, external API, credential lookup, or model inference.
